questions.question: In His prayer to the Father, what did Jesus say eternal life is?

answers.text: Knowing the only true God and Jesus Christ
Living forever without ever growing old
Keeping every law without one slip

questions.question: What did Jesus ask the Father to do for His disciples instead of taking them out of the world?

answers.text: Keep them from the evil one
Make them powerful in the world
Hide them away for a while

questions.question: Besides His disciples, who else did Jesus pray for in His prayer to the Father?

answers.text: Those who would believe through the disciples' message
Those who would reject the disciples' message
Those who would rule over the disciples' nation

questions.question: Jesus prayed that all believers would be one. What reason did He give for this?

answers.text: So the world may believe the Father sent Him
So they can outnumber all their enemies
So they will never have to disagree
